copyGuidance.single: One serving copy has the lowest storage cost, but an infrastructure or media failure can remove the only immediately available copy.
copyGuidance.replicated: Extra replicas can keep reads or failover available, but they do not protect against a logical delete or corruption being replicated.
copyGuidance.multiRegion: Additional regions change the outage boundary only when routing, data replication, quotas, and promotion have been rehearsed.
copyGuidance.backup: Backups preserve a historical recovery point. Their benefit is credible only after a timed restore and data-integrity check.
